messages.author: 40e173783f466ae0
messages.subject: error with dHMMo
parts:
Hi folks,

I'm trying to use the dHMMo distribution but when I try to run nimbleModel() on the model, data, etc., I'm getting an error of:

Error: In dHMMo: Invalid value of x[t]

I'm sure I made a coding error somewhere, but can't seem to track it down. I assume its something I provided incorrectly or failed to provide as there aren't any x's in my model.

Happy to share the code/ data.

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: error with dHMMo
parts:
hi Tim,

That error message is rather sparse in detail! I've made a GitHub issue for us to consider enhancing the information provided.

In our codebase, I see the error message is based on this check:

```
if (xt > nObsClasses | xt < 1) stop("In dDHMMo: Invalid value of x[t].")
```

So it appears that your x[t] is less than 1 or greater than the maximum possible value for some `t`. So as a first step, try checking your initial values. If that doesn't help, please do provide code and data (off-list if necessary).

-chris

messages.author: 40e173783f466ae0
messages.subject: Re: error with dHMMo
parts:
Yup, It was an error in the data I was providing to the model. Serves me right for not 2x checking the raw data! I was also able to track down what was causing the error by running a non-marginalized version.

Thanks!
